name: Florida statutory deadline, retainage and tax checks
edition: Statutes as in force on 1 November 2026
description: Runs the checks the statutory engines compute from the Florida tables: the 45 day notice to owner, the 90 day claim of lien and its 15 day service, the one year enforcement window, public retainage above 5 percent on a contract over 200 thousand dollars, county surtax charged above the first 5,000 dollars of a single item, an estimate at the 6 percent state rate, and a local wage clause in a public contract dated from 30 September 2026.
